title: Download authorized dynamic purchase-order report page as PDF
description: Download exactly the selected purchase-order report page as a paginated Chinese PDF. Reuse ERP-125 scoped preview and grouped original-currency page subtotals; require the current user's purchase-order menu on every download. Use existing PDFsharp and shared SimHei resolver; missing font fails explicitly. Existing HTTP operation audit records the read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify PDF and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses authorized bounded purchase-order preview and optional grouping, rechecks current-user menu permission and invalid fields/filters before returning bytes.
PDFsharp renders selected columns, Chinese text, original currency and separate page subtotals with bounded pagination; shared SimHei resolver fails explicitly if font unavailable.

Designer offers PDF download and visible empty/authorization/font failures; tests inspect PDF signature, selected fields, page bounds, currency separation and missing-font behavior; document prerequisites.
